verdict.rationale: Groq's docs describe how rate limits change across tiers: Flex processing gives paid customers 10x higher rate limits than on-demand, Batch jobs don't count against standard rate limits, and upgrading unlocks higher token limits. However, the pack contains no actual rate-limit page with per-model or per-tier numbers. A developer can see that limits scale, but not what the limits are before hitting them. Missing for 10: a documented rate-limits page with concrete RPM/TPM/RPD values per model and tier, the free vs developer tier limit numbers, guidance on rate-limit headers and 429 handling, and independent corroboration.
